Given a Door `m` of Workstream `w1` that started a child `c` with `agent.spawn` (so `c`'s `parent` is `m`, or a Subagent of `m` that is above `c` on the Rail), a second Workstream `w2` with its Door `n` and child `d`, then (a) `terminal.screen`, `terminal.read` and `terminal.search` called by `m` on `c`'s primary Terminal, and on the primary Terminal of a grandchild `m` started through `c`, return X13's results and write no byte; the same call by `c` on its own parent's Terminal is `FORBIDDEN`. (b) The same calls by `m` on `d`'s Terminal, on `n`'s, on a Terminal owned by an Agent of `w2`, and by `c` on a sibling's Terminal that `c` did not start, are `FORBIDDEN`, and the error message names the Terminal id, the caller's id and the reason `not started by <caller> or in its Reach`; the message is never empty, and an unknown id stays `NOT_FOUND` before `FORBIDDEN` (M13). (c) A Terminal read refused reads nothing and logs no Touch. (d) The user and an Extension have no limit (M13), and an Agent's read of its own pane stays `FORBIDDEN` (M13's policy). Tests in `crates/rupd/tests`, through the real Daemon with the fake `claude` and the fake Terminal printing a distinct word per Agent: `b54_a_door_reads_its_own_childs_terminal`, `b54_a_door_reads_a_grandchilds_terminal`, `b54_a_child_cannot_read_its_parents_terminal`, `b54_another_workstreams_terminal_is_refused_with_the_reason`, `b54_a_sibling_it_did_not_start_is_refused`, `b54_a_refused_read_reads_nothing_and_logs_no_touch`, `b54_an_unknown_id_is_not_found_before_forbidden`. typos.source: **B41 a wake request asks to be woken when named Agents finish.** Found by the owner's request #2218: "Our CLI must have full parity with the MCP"; 98 of the owner's Solo calls were `timer_fire_when_idle_all` and `_any`; "events are more accurate - we should have exactly once gurantee to avoid waste or loss". Contract change (B45). Given Agent `w` (any Agent, a Door included) and Agents `c1 … cn` in its Project, when `w` calls `agent.wake {ids: [c1 … cn], any?: bool}`, then the Daemon saves one Wake request (`GLOSSARY.md`) for `w` and returns at once `{id, fired}`; `w` ends its turn, holds no call open and no process runs for it. A Kind is *finished* when it is `idle`, `done`, `error` or `needs-you`; `working` and `blocked` are not. (a) Already finished: an id whose Kind is finished when the request is made counts as finished at once, so a request whose condition already holds fires at once (B42) and returns `fired: true`. (b) `all` (the default): the request fires when every named Agent has been finished at some time since the request; a name that finished and then resumed stays finished (the request keeps the set, so nothing is lost to a flip). `any` fires when the first named Agent is finished. (c) Gone: a named Agent that is removed counts as finished with Kind `done`. (d) Refusals, none saving anything: a caller that is not an Agent (the user, an Extension) `FORBIDDEN`; an id that names no Agent in the Project `NOT_FOUND`; the caller's own id, no ids, a repeated id or more than 20 ids `INVALID_PARAMS`; more than 8 open requests for `w` `CONFLICT`. (e) No clock: the Daemon sets no timer for a Wake request; it decides from `agent.status` Events only, and a request whose condition never holds stays saved and costs nothing. (f) A request is `w`'s: it ends with `w` (B9: `w` `done`, or its Attempt ended without a resume, or removed) and is dropped without a note. Tests in `crates/rupd` through the real Daemon with the fake `claude` and the fake clock: `b41_a_request_returns_at_once_and_holds_nothing_open`, `b41_an_already_finished_agent_fires_at_once`, `b41_all_waits_for_every_named_agent_and_keeps_a_flip_finished`, `b41_any_fires_on_the_first`, `b41_a_removed_agent_counts_as_done`, `b41_refusals_save_nothing` (table: each code of (d)), `b41_no_timer_is_set` (the fake clock advanced 24 hours fires nothing and changes no status), `b41_a_request_ends_with_its_agent`.
